engine: DesignCraft web (OTE build: official source + add_font export)

patch.summary: apps/designcraft-web exports add_font(bytes) → FontDb::global().add_font; no engine changes
patch.build: cargo build --release -p designcraft-web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown; wasm-bindgen --target web --weak-refs
patch.optimisation: none: wasm-opt from binaryen 108 produced a module whose externref table could not grow at start-up; gzipped, the unoptimised module is within about 5% of the official optimised one

wrapper: Same-origin document and font handoff, chunked module integrity checks and load-state messages.
